entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's sad to see only guys in here for[n]Christmas Eve...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't remind me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What about when you were our age, Boss?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Actually, things were pretty similar.[n]I usually spent Christmas Eve alone.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I had a bunch of girls back then. Avoiding[n]public dates was the only way I made sure[n]they never met.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You were a real player...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Now that I think about it, this is absurd.[n]This is the night prior to the birthday[n]of a great man, yes?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Why do those without significant others[n]have to feel so ashamed?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, that's just what I was thinkin'!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If you go to a convenience store, there's[n]always some couple takin' forever at the[n]register!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes. I would love some cake or fried[n]chicken, but going alone to get them[n]is embarrassing...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: This stuff sounds pretty pitiful for the[n]Phantom Thieves that just saved the[n]world, don't you think?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Hey, you're not keepin' anyone a secret[n]from me, are ya?
Of course not.
I am.
Who knows?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I knew it! We're always gonna be best[n]bros!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems even with all your skill, you were[n]unable to steal a woman's heart.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, you freakin' serious!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What would be strange about that?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, I'm gonna call you tonight[n]and find out.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Don't, Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You know, a man's charm is honed not[n]just in meetings... but in partings too.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: With the painful parting you guys went[n]through, I'm sure you've become much[n]better men.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I think it's about time I go on my way.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, I'm outta here too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Thanks for the drink.
